title: [dogfood:P2] cmd/gen-types ships with no --help/usage; bare invocation fails cryptically
detail: go run ./cmd/gen-types --help prints 'no schema files found' and exits 1 (no usage text); bare run prints 'usage: gen-types <schema_glob>...' then exits 1. Correct invocation (go run ./cmd/gen-types 'protocol/schemas/v1/*.json' → 15 files validated) is discoverable only via the //go:generate comment in protocol/types.go. h3-consensus-adapter, by contrast, has proper -flag help.
